# A synthetic file list standing in for a large repository, committed so the tier split's
# behaviour is RE-DERIVABLE by someone who was not there.
#
# gate.go used to instruct "re-measure required/deferred on real repos after any edit here" and
# cite ghola @4f33b3c, roboticus (no sha) and counterspy (no sha) — private, unpinned, and in one
# case a sha that no longer resolves. That instruction was unfollowable, while README and the C4 doc
# both claimed "the measurements live in comments beside the tests that pin them". No test pinned
# hDeferFloor at all: lowering it kept CI green.
#
# 70 paths: 40 tier-1 (money) and 30 tier-2 (network), so the list exceeds hDeferFloor (60) and the
# split actually engages. TestTheTierSplitIsReDerivableFromAFixture asserts the outcome.
